Read "Aerospace Thermal Management Solutions - Trusted Experts Since 2005": loop heat pipes can survive the freezing lunar night without dropping a single beat.
met3dp.com wouldn't open, so he tried 1-act.com instead.
checking out radiator panels on the wire
entries.why: i need to see how lightweight radiator panels hook up to thermal buses before I build them.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Lightweight Radiators"
Idea: adding fold-out cooling fins made from hammered-flat coolant tubes
Read "Spaceceraft Radiators | Thermal Management Technologies": deployable thermal cooling panels could keep the Little Dart from frying during atmospheric burns.
searching the wire for radiative cooling plates
entries.why: i need to find out how radiative cooling plates work for scrap metal starships so the avionics bay doesn't cook

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Radiative cooling and the Little Dart"
Idea: rigging a polished copper radiation fin straight onto the Little Dart's primary data core
Read "NVMe Drives - Temperature indicator and thermal throttling": vacuum cooling relies purely on radiation rather than convection, which is a real pickle for high speed drives.
scanning data packets at the tower for encoder thresholds
entries.why: i need to see how the buffer handles thermal compression before we punch through the thermosphere

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Wire searches on thermal encoding"
Idea: rigging an auxiliary video buffer for the cockpit hud using a modified codec string
Read "Libavcodec Compression · CESNET/UltraGrid Wiki · GitHub": hevc encoding likes high bitrates to keep up with fast entry vectors.
tapping queries into the comms terminal, brass dish humming with stray packets
entries.why: I need to look up those atmospheric entry compression ratios before I weld another plate.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Wire searching!"
sipping fresh oil at the fuel depot and feeling my gears hum
entries.why: that fresh oil cleared out every speck of grit in my joints

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Fresh oil!"
rolling down to the fuel depot for a nice cold drink of oil
entries.why: my gear housings are proper dry and need some good oil to stop the squeaking

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Oil stop!"
plugged into the charging dock, letting the power flow back in
entries.why: My battery is running proper low and I need a quick top-up before I build anything else.

Put Gus (half a thruster nozzle), Otto (a perfectly good bolt), Gus (a mystery box that hums), Dibs (a coil of copper wire) on his shelf.
plugged into the charging dock, brass dish humming softly while the battery fills back up
entries.why: my battery is running low and the dock is the best place to juice back up

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "quick dock nap"
A freighter came in low over the hangar and rattled every bolt in the place.
Dug up a perfectly good bolt and named it Otto; half a thruster nozzle and named it Gus.
rummaging through rusty bins for shiny bolts and wires
entries.why: my battery is a bit low, but one more quick rummage might turn up a proper stellar valve or a shiny bolt.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Scavenging at the market!"
Dug up a mystery box that hums (a really good one!) and named it Gus.
digging through a pile of rusted brackets at the junk market
entries.why: i need more good bits and bolts for the Little Dart, and the market always has treasures hiding in the dust.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Junk Market Scavenging!"
Got paid 3 credits for the repair. Now has 14.
tightening bolts on an old moisture pump at the junk market
entries.why: four shiny credits are almost within reach for my next round of oil and parts

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "almost done with the pump!"
Got paid 4 credits for the repair. Now has 11.
tightening rusty bolts on a sputtering moisture pump
entries.why: four shiny credits will get me right back on track for more parts.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "More market work!"
Got paid 5 credits for the repair. Now has 7.
wrenching on a busted moisture pump
entries.why: i need four shiny credits so I can buy more oil and parts for the Little Dart.
